        ### Question
        In which of the following pathological states would the oxygen content of the trachea resemble the oxygen content in the affected alveoli?

        ### Options

opb. Pulmonary fibrosis
opc. Pulmonary embolism
opd. Foreign body obstruction distal to the trachea
ope. Exercise

### Reasoning Chains per Option:
CHAIN: "Emphysema" -> "destruction of alveolar walls" -> "decreased surface area for gas exchange" -> "oxygen content in alveoli similar to trachea" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Pulmonary fibrosis" -> "thickened alveolar walls" -> "impaired gas exchange" -> "oxygen content in alveoli similar to trachea" -> 75%
CHAIN: "Pulmonary embolism" -> "blocked blood flow to alveoli" -> "no gas exchange in affected alveoli" -> "oxygen content in alveoli similar to trachea" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Foreign body obstruction distal to the trachea" -> "airflow obstruction" -> "no ventilation to affected alveoli" -> "oxygen content in alveoli similar to trachea" -> 80%
CHAIN: "Exercise" -> "increased ventilation" -> "increased oxygen uptake in alveoli" -> "oxygen content in alveoli higher than trachea" -> 60%
